annotations.title: Today's sky: planets, Moon and retrogrades

description: Where the Sun, Moon and planets are (tropical zodiac sign and degree), which planets are retrograde, and the Moon phase, computed from real astronomy for now or any date. Covers questions like 'what sign is the Moon in', 'is Mercury retrograde', 'where are the planets today', 'today's astrology'. Facts only, no horoscope text. Uses the location the client shares when no city is given.

city.description: Optional. City name. Omit to use the user's location.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone. Omit to use the user's location.
